name: work-band
description: A one-line band above the prompt: the stage and progress of a superpowers flow, another skill or Claude's own to-do list; the last test run; the request's time; and how many subagents are running. Comes back on resume.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: on (default) runs the mod; off turns it off everywhere, on every surface (the switch-board panel flips this)

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en or ko

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills the band shows besides superpowers', comma-separated: a full name (impeccable) or a plugin prefix (taste-skill:). Empty shows them all

testCommands.title: Test commands
testCommands.description: More command prefixes that count as a test run, comma-separated (for example: just test, ./run-tests.sh)

terminal.title: Show in terminal
terminal.description: off (default) draws the band and the agents panel only in the desktop app (and other app surfaces); on draws them in the terminal too
